title: [finding] `liveness/field.json` inline-column `prefix`/`scale` notes and the `field-scale.ts` docblock still describe the pre-objectui#10355 grid (`c.prefix || '¥'`, `c.scale ?? 2`)
body:
## Finding

Two notes in `packages/spec` describe objectui grid code that has moved:

- `packages/spec/liveness/field.json`, the `inlineColumns.children.prefix` and `.scale` notes, still cite `c.prefix || '¥'` and `c.scale ?? currency default 2` as the reads. objectui `GridField.tsx:1132-1133` (objectui#10355) reads `currencyAdornment(c, currency, locale)` and "never a default `¥`", and PR #20223 (card #20045) refuses `scale` on a currency inline column at parse.
- `packages/spec/src/data/field-scale.ts`, the docblock sentence "The one `2` that looks like a currency default belongs to an inline grid COLUMN's rounding", describes the same pre-#10355 grid.

Neither is published text (a liveness ledger note and a TS docblock on an internal helper), so PR #20223 correctly left them outside its surface and recorded them as "carrier: none".

## Where it was found

PR #20223's body (「Stale notes outside this surface」) and its contract-review record 5856253884 (③, first flag), which asked for a carrier. This card is it; nothing in #20223 changes for it.

## Fix

Re-read both objectui sites at the time of the fix and rewrite the two notes to the reads that exist then: `prefix` replaces the resolved currency's symbol with no default; `scale` is refused on a currency inline column and is a `number` column's rounding width. Notes only; no schema, export or behaviour moves. If the liveness ledger's own gate (`Spec property liveness`) wants a re-measurement stamp on the edited entries, carry it.

## Acceptance

- Neither note cites `'¥'` as a default or `c.scale ?? 2` as a currency read.
- `Spec property liveness` and `Lint & Repo Gates` green.
- Changeset: none (no published surface).

Clause-②: no
